products.title: Premium Italian Buttero Leather Golf Yardage Book Cover / Scorecard Holder- Natural
products.body_html:
Premium Italian Buttero Leather Golf Scorecard Holder - Natural

Handcrafted from genuine Buttero leather sourced from Conceria Walpier in Italy, this scorecard holder is as close to the raw material as it gets. Natural Buttero starts with that clean, undyed finish—pale and almost waxy out of the box—and then it's entirely up to you where it goes from there.

The Natural colorway is for the leather obsessive. It's the blank canvas of Bluegrass Fairway scorecard holders, and it rewards use more than any other leather we carry.

What Makes It Special: No other leather in our lineup patinas quite like Natural Buttero. Every round you play, every time you pull it from your back pocket, you're adding to it. Sun exposure deepens the tone, oils from your hands burnish the surface, and over months and years it transforms into a rich, amber-toned piece that's entirely your own. It's a slow build—and that's exactly the point. They're built to fit most standard scorecards and yardage books, including PGA Tour yardage books (we've had a few tour players and caddies carry them, which is pretty cool).

Specs:

  • Dimensions: 7.25" H × 4.25" W (closed)
  • Fits comfortably in your back pocket
  • Custom heat-stamped initials available (inside)

The Real Deal: We use full-grain hides that show the authentic marks of the animal's life—bug bites, scars, brand marks, barbed wire scratches, natural wrinkles. These aren't flaws; they're what make your holder one-of-a-kind. No two are identical, and that's the point.
